# sophosfirewall_fqdn_address (Resource)

Manages an FQDN address object (*Objects > Hosts and services > FQDN host*).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sophosfirewall_fqdn_address" "updates" {
  name = "vendor-updates"
  fqdn = "*.updates.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `fqdn` (String) Fully qualified domain name, e.g. `www.example.com` or `*.example.com`.
- `name` (String) Unique name of the FQDN address object.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-text description.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the object assigned by the firewall.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by name or UUID.
terraform import sophosfirewall_fqdn_address.example <name-or-uuid>
```
